svg.title: Japan at a glance infographic
svg.desc: Static SVG infographic about Japan with a stylized map, city markers, GDP bar chart, nationality composition pie chart, and travel highlights. No JavaScript.
svg.text: Cities, economy, people, and trip ideas in one compact page
Approximate positions on a stylized Japan map

text.tspan: Japan stretches from snowy Hokkaido to
subtropical islands, but much of its population
and industry is concentrated along the Pacific
side of Honshu. The marked cities form a
powerful urban corridor connected by high-speed
rail.
Japan is a technologically advanced island nation with deep cultural layers: temples, food traditions, pop
culture, mountainous landscapes, and some of the world’s most recognizable urban experiences.
The bars use nominal GDP in current US
dollars, so exchange-rate movement matters.
Japan held near the $5T level through
2019–2021, then the dollar value fell in
2022–2024 while remaining one of the world’s
largest economies.

svg.text: Source series: World Bank via FRED. Values rounded in labels.
Note: category wording follows World Factbook/OpenFactBook; “Vietnam” is shown as Vietnamese here.

text.tspan: Start with Tokyo for neighborhoods, food, design
and night views. Add Kyoto for temples and
gardens, Osaka for street food, Hiroshima and
Miyajima for history and scenery, and Mount Fuji
or Hakone for iconic landscapes. In winter,
Hokkaido adds snow, seafood and open space.

svg.text: Static SVG · no JavaScript · Data: World Bank/FRED GDP 2015–2024; World Factbook nationality shares; major-city order from Japan travel/city listings.
